notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_H10/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/hegemony_H10.py; issue 759). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 21.0, the Battleship class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. No parts list here: the sheet places every part. game_code H10_23 is the Battleship folder the game picks for hegemony (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake none: the Hegemony paint stack is a later job (contrib/muse/design/paint_direction_2026_11/hegemony.md); no PC recipe run until the Board and Ryan have looked at the sheet.
